name: Browser tools (pinned Chrome)
description: Pinned Google Chrome from Google's signed apt repo for Kilo Code browser automation: Kilo's Playwright backend launches the system Chrome channel (/opt/google/chrome/chrome), so the pin is independent of Kilo's bundled Playwright revision. Chrome plus its library deps is a few hundred MB; installs the deps Playwright's own Chromium fallback needs too. Debian/Ubuntu only (fails closed on Fedora). Headless needs no container flags, but default launches run with Chrome's sandbox disabled (Playwright chromiumSandbox default): a exploited page has the container user's full access. For the real sandbox add --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN; it is not enabled by default.

chrome.description: google-chrome-stable apt version (exact four-part pin from Google's signed repo; no release feed to track, so pin updates are manual, like gcloud). 'none' skips the install.
